description: List past micro-batch identity match calls for the org. Returns run_id, match_count, match_rate, field_list, created_at, and expires_at. Results are cursor-paginated — pass next_cursor as cursor to fetch older pages. The before timestamp is a legacy alternative. Reported subscription capacity consumption is an estimate in USD; final rated consumption may differ. Use to audit recent match activity, inspect subscription capacity consumption, or find a specific run by scanning pages. Requires 'discovery' scope.

before.description: Legacy ISO timestamp cursor — returns runs created before this time. Use the created_at of the last run in a previous response to paginate.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page; mutually exclusive with before

name: list_match_runs

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: List Match Runs
